entry.title: Updated: dsh-code-check
entry.summary: Automatic type-check diagnostics: after the model edits or creates TS files, runs `tsc --noEmit` in the background (debounced per project) and reports errors via the `code_check` tool — grouped by file with line/column, severity and TS error codes, closing the "edit → check → fix" loop. Exact install spec: github:a179-sanae/dsh-code-check. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
